document_strings: You encourage everyone to live it! <3
♀ like glitter ♂ like home-ade Beauty is subjective? xo, [redacted] 1/2003

Ingredients: 2 cups butter 2 1/2 cups sugar 2 cups brown sugar 4 eggs 2 tbl vanilla 4 cups flour 5 cups oatmeal (before grinding) 1 tsp srit 2 tsp baking powder 2 tsp baking soda 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa 1 24 oz bag chocolate chips (semi sweet)

Directions: preheat oven to 350° grind 5 cups oatmeal in blender (will reduce to approx 4 cups ground), mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. drop dough in rounded spoonfuls onto non stick cookie sheet, bake 8-10 minutes (makes approx 60-80 cookies depending on size)
